Ticket:
Confused about batch claim validation errors

Hello, I am trying to push out the weekly insurance claims for our providers, but the system keeps flagging a bunch of them with error code V-402 right before batch submission. I am not really sure what this error means or how I am supposed to fix the validation issues on these specific forms. Could someone please walk me through how to correct them so we can get our claims sent off to the clearinghouse? Thank you.
